text:
Anya: Quick thread  Portland LLM Night confirmed July 12. We have a tabletop, 8-minute lightning demo, and 50 swag bags. Need owners: demo prep, speaker submission, swag pack, shipping, and lead capture. Can someone take speaker submission by EOD?

Ravi: I can submit. Will trim our latency vs cost slides to 4 slides + demo snippet. Any constraints on sample code?

June: For slides keep code < 3 lines. I can do a micro-benchmark handout for the table. Deadline June 28.

Marco: I'll handle swag packs. Proposal: 200 stickers, 50 postcards, 50 enamel pins. Vendor: pinpal.co. PO #PO-6110. ETA Jul 5. Pins add cost but seem popular.

Leah: Shipping logistics: send to venue hold for pickup. I'll be onsite contact. Need tracking by Jul 8. Also confirm table layout and power.

ops-bot: Venue confirmed: Observatory Hall. Power: 1x outlet per table. Arrival window Jul 12 8am-9am.

Anya: Lead routing plan: QR -> short Typeform -> webhook -> HubSpot list "Portland Night" -> assign to Marco for 48h then SDR. Marco, can you own the form and Zap?

Marco: Yep. Form fields: name, email, company, interest checkbox (benchmarks/integration/demo). Zapier draft will POST to HubSpot with utm_source=portland_night.

Ravi: I'll add utm to demo link and upload final slides by Jul 6. Also need a 1-line speaker bio + headshot.

June: Uploading handout draft now to the drive. Will include 1 chart (2-token vs 1k-tail) and 3 integration tips.

Leah: Shipping contact: HarborShip courier, tracking HS334455. I'll confirm hold and attachment to PO.

Anya: Dry run Jul 10 @ 9am PT. Recap owners: Ravi = speaker + demo link, June = handout, Marco = swag packs + lead form, Leah = shipping + onsite. I'll create the runbook and add arrival checklist. Thanks! :raised_hands:
